audit_2026_10_18: Source audit (live Carto SQL API, 2026-10-18): table `permits`, 938,834 rows all-time (2007-present), 47 columns. Trailing-12-month window on permitissuedate >= 2025-10-17: 45,900 rows = 45,900 distinct permitnumber = 45,900 distinct objectid = 45,900 distinct cartodb_id; systemofrecord = ECLIPSE on all window rows; zero posse_jobid repeats in the window; parentjobid non-empty on 17,017 window rows (project linkage, distinct permits). All dated rows carry permitissuedate except Refused/Denied applications that never issued (2,503 all-time). NO valuation/cost column exists anywhere in the schema; NO application-date column exists. contractorname present on 39,964 of 45,900 window rows; zip on 45,728; commercialorresidential NULL on 339 (all Administrative). September 2026 source count: 3,649 (cross-check target). Freshest permitissuedate in the table: 2026-10-17T04:00:00Z (the day before the pull). OpenDataPhilly's legacy CKAN API is retired (the catalog migrated to JKAN in spring 2023 — /api/3 returns 404); the catalog's data.json record for this dataset points its CSV/API resources at this same Carto endpoint.
coverage_note: Permits issued by the City of Philadelphia (Department of Licenses and Inspections) only. Philadelphia is a consolidated city-county, so this city feed covers the whole of Philadelphia County.

dedupe_rule.definition: One published permit = one row of the L&I permits table, identified by its permit number (permitnumber). The trailing-12-month window is entirely ECLIPSE-system records and the permit number is exactly unique there, so every window row is counted once. parentjobid links 17,017 window rows to a parent job (for example a trade permit issued under a building-permit job), but those are distinct L&I permits carrying distinct permit numbers — the separate permits the city issued — not duplicate rows of the parent.
dedupe_rule.measurement: Trailing-12-month window (permitissuedate >= 2025-10-17), measured 2026-10-18 against the live Carto table: 45,900 rows = 45,900 distinct permitnumber = 45,900 distinct objectid = 45,900 distinct cartodb_id, and zero posse_jobid values repeat within the window. All-time, the table carries 938,834 rows vs 938,610 distinct permit numbers: the 224 surplus rows are legacy POSSE-era bare-number permits (e.g. '14995', each appearing exactly twice, 0.024% of the table), none of them in the ECLIPSE window. The pipeline's in-batch duplicate gate and the (county_id, source_record_id) upsert key guard every future pull.
dedupe_rule.rule: source_record_id = permitnumber; count every window row once.

field_map.application_date: NOT PUBLISHED — the dataset carries no application-date column (it publishes issue, completion, denial, and certificate-of-occupancy dates only), so application_date stays NULL by construction
field_map.category: commercialorresidential (Residential / Commercial, the source's own class; NULL on 339 of 45,900 window rows, all Administrative permits)
field_map.contractor_rule: contractorname ONLY — L&I's published contractor of record on the permit (the licensed business or tradesperson the permit names; present on 39,964 of 45,900 window rows). opa_owner (the property owner — a person/homeowner field) is never requested: it is excluded from the pull's column list entirely, as are the contractor address fields and the geometry column.
field_map.issue_date: permitissuedate (the issuance-date field; every dated row in the table carries one except Refused/Denied applications that never issued — 2,503 rows all-time)
field_map.permit_type: permitdescription (the source's own permit label, e.g. 'Plumbing Permit'; falls back to permittype)
field_map.valuation: NOT PUBLISHED BY THE SOURCE — the dataset's 47 columns carry no cost or valuation field at all (full schema verified 2026-10-18), so Philadelphia publishes counts, trades, categories, and monthly volumes only. No dollar figure is computed, estimated, or published for this county.

update_cadence: daily — the OpenDataPhilly catalog record is stamped modified R/P1D (daily); measured 2026-10-18: the freshest permitissuedate in the table is 2026-10-17, the day before the pull (the ECLIPSE system of record loads nightly). Freshness for this feed is measured as the freshest permitissuedate in the Carto table — the table exposes no dataset-level updated stamp through its SQL API.
watermark_field: permitissuedate + permitnumber (issue-date window; identity = permitnumber — see dedupe_rule)
